cases.name: Jessica Antolini
cases.about: On a Facebook post, her mother Suzanne Rys Antolini said: "Jessica was a beloved child, cherished sister and treasured friend. Jess was a kind and loving person who advocated for the rights of all people and for animal welfare."
cases.narrative:
On 10/15/2026, she died of her injuries. He allegedly shot her and ran her over with his car, resulting in her death, while his 5-year-old daughter was inside the vehicle. Police allege Smith went to a bar to look for Antolini with his 5-year-old daughter, according to an affidavit obtained by PEOPLE.

Witnesses who knew Smith told officers that he was acting “extremely strangely” and was walking around the bar as if he was “possessed,” appearing to be “hunting down Antolini” in an aggressive manner, the affidavit alleges.

Upon locating her, Smith is accused of engaging in a verbal argument with Antolini in the parking lot. After he walked over to his vehicle, police allege that Antolini followed him before Smith produced a firearm and shot her “in the face, through her left eye, and out the rear of her skull,” according to the affidavit. After the shooting, Smith is accused of fleeing the scene with his daughter “running over Antolini’s body in the process,” per the affidavit.
